name: blog-schema
description: > Generate JSON-LD for ONE blog post (BlogPosting with Person, Organization, BreadcrumbList, ImageObject, VideoObject; FAQPage only as optional entity markup) in a single @graph, and check it against Google's current structured data support. Use when the user says "generate schema", "json-ld for this post", "blog schema". Not for auditing schema across a whole site or other schema types (claude-seo seo-schema), not for product pages, and not a promise of rich results: FAQ rich results ended 2026
author: AgriciDaniel
